moments.text: Infrared sensor view over broken grey clouds, with a crosshair, tilting horizon bars and black redaction boxes. The view pans and rolls across the cloud tops.
A small box appears below the crosshair, then grows around a small dark spot just below centre.
The box turns into two vertical bars that hold the dark spot just below the crosshair while clouds slide past and the picture dims and brightens.
A large dark cloud bank streaks through the view, then clears; the dark spot is back between the bars by 26.3 s.
The background turns to a darker textured surface. The dark spot slips down-right out of the bars, which widen, and drifts toward the lower right.
The dark spot is gone; at 29.55 s the display switches back to its plain search crosshair as the clip ends.

notes: Black pillarbox bars left/right not cropped (crop None).
